spans.s: उत (I) a. (f. ता) Woven.

उत (II) ind. A particle expressing- (1) doubt, indecision (or), तत्किमयतमातपदोषः स्यादुत यथा मे मनसि वर्तते Sak.iii., पिबामः शास्त्रौधानुत विविधकाव्यामृतरसान् Bhartr.iii.40; (2) alternative, option (or), K.S.vi.23 (in these two senses it is usually a correlative of किम् meaning ‘whether’); (3) connection, association (and, also), अधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत Bg.ii.29; (4) interrogation. (Sometimes it is used as a mere expletive).With आहो or आहोस्वित् or स्वित्, it is used as a particle of doubt or deliberation, e.g. यक्षी वा राक्षसी वा त्वमुताहोऽसि सुरांगना.With किम्, it expresses- (1) ‘or,’ किमुत सकले जाते वाह्निप्रैयत्वामिहेष्यसि Am.
; (2) ‘how much more,’ ‘how much less’ चेतो मुनेरपि हरेत्किमुतास्मदीयम् Ch.
, or मयि नांतकोऽपि प्रभुः प्रहर्तुं किमुतान्याहिंस्राः R.ii.62.With प्रति, it means ‘on the contrary,’ सामवादाः सकोपस्य तस्य प्रत्युत दीपकाः Sis.ii.55.When repeated, it has the sense of ‘either-or.’
उत (I) a. (f. ता) Woven.
उत्त a. (f. त्ता) Wet, moist.
उत्त a. (f. त्ता) Wet, moist.
उतथ्य m. The name of a son of Angiras.
उतथ्य-अनुज, -अनुजन्मन् m. Bṛhaspati, the teacher of gods, तथ्यामुतथ्यानुजवज्जगादाग्रे गदाग्रजम् Sis.ii.69.
उतथ्य-अनुज, -अनुजन्मन् m. Bṛhaspati, the teacher of gods, तथ्यामुतथ्यानुजवज्जगादाग्रे गदाग्रजम् Sis.ii.69.

उत्तंस m.n. 1. An ear-ring, Bh.V.ii.55; 2. a crest, an ornament worn on the crown of the head. (Note. When preceded by the word कर्ण, उत्तंस loses part of its original meaning and expresses merely ‘an ornament’ according to some. According to Mammata, the word कर्ण expresses in such cases कर्ण स्थितत्व, this, however, being merely a device to explain away the usage of standard authors, कर्णावतंसादिपदे कर्णादिध्वनिनिर्मितिः । संनिधानादिबोधार्थं स्थितेष्वेतत्समर्थनम् K.Pr.vii.).
उत्तट a. (f. टा) Overflowing its banks, R.xi.58.
उत्तट a. (f. टा) Overflowing its banks, R.xi.58.
उत्तप्त n. Dried flesh.
उत्तम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Uppermost, highest; 2. most elevated, principal; 3. best, excellent, प्रायेणाधममध्यमो तमगुणः संवासतो जायते Bhartr.ii.67, Bg.i.24; 4. first, greatest, M.ii.249.
उत्तम (II) m. 1. Viṣṇu; 2. the last person equivalent to the first person in English grammar (in gram.)
उत्तम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Uppermost, highest; 2. most elevated, principal; 3. best, excellent, प्रायेणाधममध्यमो तमगुणः संवासतो जायते Bhartr.ii.67, Bg.i.24; 4. first, greatest, M.ii.249.

उत्तम-अधम a. high and low.
उत्तम-अर्ध m. the best half.
उत्तम-अह m. the last or latest day.
उत्तम-ऋण, -ऋणिक m. a creditor.
उत्तम-ऋण, -ऋणिक m. a creditor.
उत्तम-पुरुष m. 1. the last person in verbal conjugation corresponding to the first person in English grammar; 2. the supreme spirit; 3. an excellent man.
उत्तम-श्लोक a. of excellent fame, famous, illustrious, glorious.
उत्तम-स्त्रीसंग्रह m. intriguing with another man’s wife, addressing her privately &c.
उत्तम-साहस n. the highest of the three fixed fines (in law).
उत्तमीय a. (f. या) Uppermost, highest, best.
उत्तमीय a. (f. या) Uppermost, highest, best.
उत्तंभ m. 1. Upholding; 2. stopping, arresting; 3. a prop, a stay.
उत्तंभन n. 1. Upholding; 2. stopping, arresting; 3. a prop, a stay.

उत्तर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Upper, higher, तं वाहनादवनतोत्तरकायम् R.ix.60; 2. produced in the north, northern, M.v.92; 3. left; 4. later, latter, following, as in उत्तरमेघ or उत्तरमीमांसा M.ii.136; 5. superior, chief, (op. to अधर), धर्मोत्तरं मध्यममाश्रयंते R.xiii.7, xvii.12, K.S.v.61; 6. more, more than (generally as the last member of a compound in this sense), e.g. अष्टोत्तरं शतम्; 7. to be crossed over.
उत्तर (II) m. 1. Future time, futurity; 2. Viṣṇu; 3. Śiva.

उत्तर (III) n. 1. Upper surface or cover; 2. the last part of a compound; 3. an answer, प्रचक्रमे च प्रतिवक्तुमुत्तरम् R.iii.47; 4. a defend, a rejoinder (in law); 5. the fourth member of an अधिकरण (in Mīmānsā). See under अधिकरण; 6. conclusion; 7. remainder.(The inst. sing. viz., उत्तरेण is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘to the north of,’ ‘on the left side of,’ and then governs the acc. or gen. of the place referred to, e.g. तत्रागारं धनपतिगृहानुत्तरेणास्मदीयम् Megh.ii.12. Cf. दक्षिणेन.)

उत्तार m. 1. Transporting over; 2. landing; 3. getting rid of; 4. vomiting.
उत्तर-अधर a. superior and inferior.

उत्तर-अधिकारिन् m. an heir.

उत्तर-अर्ध m. 1. the upper part of the body, R.xviii.51; 2. the latter half.

उत्तर-पट m. 1. an upper garment; 2. a bed-covering.
उत्तर-पथ m. the northern way.
उत्तर-पद n. 1. the last member of a compound (in gram.); 2. a word capable of being compounded with another.
उत्तर-पश्चिमा f. the north-west.
उत्तर-पूर्वा f. the north-east.
उत्तर-प्रच्छद m. a cover-lid.
उत्तर-प्रत्युत्तर n. 1. a dispute, a discussion; 2. the pleadings in a law-suit.
उत्तर-फल्गुनी f. the 12th lunar mansion consisting of two stars.
उत्तर-भाद्रपदा f. the 26th lunar mansion consisting of two stars.

उत्ताल (II) m. An ape.
